description.en:
Farm Dashboard combines a lightweight Farming Simulator 25 mod with a free Windows desktop app. Keep playing as normal â€” the mod exports live farm data in the background while the app turns it into a full management dashboard in your browser.
In-game mod: - Silent background export â€” no hotkeys and no extra panels in FS25 - Fields, crops, soil, windrows, and bales on the map - Vehicles with fleet positions for the live map view - Livestock and husbandry totals; pen-level detail when supported - Production chains, storage fill levels, and active factory slots - Economy, market prices, finances, and weather - Single-player, multiplayer host, and dedicated server (export on authority only)
Windows app: - Home hub â€” one screen for livestock, vehicles, fields, economy, pastures, and productions - Fields â€” growth stage, Precision Farming N/pH where available, windrow and bale badges, suggested next-step hints - Livestock â€” herd summary, search and filters, per-animal health, weight, value, and location - Vehicles â€” fleet cards with condition, operating hours, cargo, and coordinates; live fleet map with map overview - Productions â€” input/output storage, recipes, cycle rates, and slot status - Economy â€” money, loans, market board, purchases, consumables, and physical bale stock - Pastures â€” grazing areas with status and warnings - Multiple local saves and dedicated servers (folder watch or FTP polling) - Live in-game clock and weather; optional LAN access from other devices on your network - Themes and 27 UI languages
Install the mod from ModHub, enable it on your save, and load into the world once. Download the Windows app and step-by-step setup (local saves, dedicated/FTP, LAN) here: https://github.com/WizardlyPayload/FarmHub/wiki
Multiplayer: only the host or dedicated server writes export data. Joined clients automatically receive a chunked local mirror (liveData.json + mirror_<slot>/data.json) for the desktop app â€” no in-game toggle; the mod does not alter gameplay.
Works alongside common mods where APIs are available (e.g. Precision Farming, Realistic Livestock, Advanced Damage System, Vehicle Years).
https://github.com/WizardlyPayload/FarmHub
